raw:
The paper includes "retrieval-augmented historical memory analysis" where an on-device LLM reasons using relevant historical records. That is RAG, since retrieved text is given to the generator. It runs experiments, with 93% coverage using memory-based reasoning. The input is 3D point clouds, but these are converted to structured text/graph for the LLM, so it is not multimodal-only RAG in the E9 sense. The RAG component is a part of the larger framework, but it is evaluated experimentally.
